fusions.name: Shot from Cover
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at the first enemy in line for 30 damage, ignoring armour. Against an enemy that has not yet been hurt, its critical chance rises by 50%.

fusions.name: Loosed Spring
fusions.desc: Launches you up to 8 tiles onto an enemy for 16 damage, rising to 2 times that from full range. It uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage each.

fusions.name: Long Stalk
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.54 times as far.

fusions.name: Coiled Readiness
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 20% critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
